snippet.title: Riding Shotgun - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Riding Shotgun is an arcade car combat game. Players commandeer the Crimson Crucible -- driving and shooting across the Mojave mowing down hordes of relentless demons. Keep your wits about you to reach your destination; the City of Sin - Las Vegas.
